                    if (res.msg) {
                        
                        $(".msgholder-active-coupons").html('' +
						'<div class="alert alert-success" role="alert">' +
							res.msg +
						'</div>' +
					'');
                    }
                } else {
                    
                    if(res.error_fields){
                        $.each(res.error_fields, function( index, value ) {						
                            $("#active-coupons_form " + index).css({
                                    'border': '1px solid #F00'
                            }).after('<small class="error">' + value + '</small>');
                        });
                    }else if(res.msg){
                        $(".msgholder-active-coupons").html('' +
						'<div class="alert alert-danger" role="alert">' +
							res.msg +
						'</div>' +
					'');
                    }
                }
            }
    }).submit();
});

/*  LOAD CART

function loadCart() {
	$.ajax({
		type: "POST",
		url: SITEURL + "/ajax/cart.php",
		data: 'loadcart=1',
		dataType: "html",
		cache: false,
		success: function (html) {
			$('#cart-header').html(html);
		}
	});
}

	$( ".send-fast-order" ).on( "click", function(e) {
		e.preventDefault();
		
		$("#fast_order_form").ajaxForm({
			target: "#msgholder-order",
			beforeSubmit: function(){
				$.LoadingOverlay("show");
			},
			type: 'POST',
			url: SITEURL + "/ajax/orders.php",
			resetForm : 0,
			clearForm : 0,
			dataType: 'json',
			data: {
				processFastOrderCoupon: 1,
				qty: qty,
				price: price,
				productid: productid,
				couponid: couponid
			},
			success: function(res){
				if(res.status == 1){
					var sel = $('#dynamicModal'),
						body = sel.find('.modal-body'),
						footer = sel.find('.modal-footer');
						
					body.html('<div class="payment-success-icon fa fa-check-circle-o"></div>' +
					'<div class="payment-success-title-area">' +
						'<p class="lead margin0">' +
							'Благодарим Ви, ще пазарувахте в Хеликон!</strong>' +
							'<h4 class="fast-payment-success-title">Вашата поръчка бе изпратена <span style="color: #03944d;">успешно</span>!</h4>' +
						'</p>' +
						'<hr class="margin-tb-10" />' +
						'<p class="margin0">' +
							'Ще се свържем максимално бързо с Вас, за да уточним адреса за доставка. Очаквайте обаждане на посочения от Вас телефон.' +
//                                                        '<div style="color: red; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid; padding: 10px;"><p>Уважаеми клиенти,</p><p>Във връзка с предстоящия празник 3 март, моля имайте предвид, че Виртуална книжарница Хеликон ще приема вашите поръчки без прекъсване.</p><p>Поръчки приети на 02.03 до 14,00 часа ще бъдат обработени и доставени на 03.03 до 14,00 часа. Поръчки приети на 03, 04 и 05.03 ще бъдат обработени на 06.03 и ще достигнат до адреси на 07.03 и 08.03 за София и страната.</p></div>' +
						'</p>' +
					'</div>');
					
					footer.html('<a href="javascript:;" class="btn btn-lg btn-primary" data-dismiss="modal">Затвори</a>');
				} else if(res.status == 2){
                                    if(res.msg){
                                                $("#msgholder-order").html('' +
						'<div class="alert alert-danger" role="alert">' +
							res.msg +
						'</div>' +
					'');
					}
                                }else {
					if(res.msg){
						$("#msgholder-order").html(res.msg);
						$("html, body").animate({
							scrollTop: 0
						}, 600);
					}
					
					if(res.error_fields){
						//Reset input styles
						$("[data-name], input[type='text'], select, textarea").css({
							'border': '1px solid #ccc'
						});
						$('.checkbox-inline').css({
							'border': 'none',
							'background': 'none'
						});
						$(".error").remove();
						
						$.each(res.error_fields, function( index, value ) {
							var selector = $("#fast_order_form " + index);
							
							if(selector.is("input[type='checkbox']")){
								selector.parent().parent('.checkbox-inline').css({
									'border': '1px solid #F00',
									'background': '#FFF7F7'
								}).after('<small class="error" style="color: F00;">' + value + '</small>');
							} else {
								selector.css({
									'border': '1px solid #F00'
								}).after('<small class="error" style="color: F00;">' + value + '</small>');
							}
						});
					}
				}
				
				$.LoadingOverlay("hide");
			}
		}).submit();
	});
	
});

/*  ADD TO CART CONTROLS
/*===================================================================================*/
function add_to_cart(id,price){
        
        var qty = 1;
        
	$.ajax({
            type: "POST",
            url: SITEURL + "/ajax/cart.php",
            beforeSend: function(){
                    $.LoadingOverlay("show");
            },
            dataType: 'json',
            data: {
                    addtocart: id,
                    qty: qty,
                    price: price
            },
            success: function (res) {
                if(res.status == 1){
                    window.location.replace(SITEURL + "/cart/");
                } else {
                    alert(res.msg);
                }
                //$.LoadingOverlay("hide");
            }
	});
	return false;
}
$( ".add-to-cart-btn" ).on( "click", function(e) {
	e.preventDefault();
//        console.log(e);
//        console.log($(e));
//        console.log(e.currentTarget.dataset.id);
//        console.log(e.currentTarget.dataset.price);
//        .target.dataset.id
        var type0 = $('select[name="type0"]').find(":selected").val();
        var type1 = $('select[name="type1"]').find(":selected").val();
        var type2 = $('select[name="type2"]').find(":selected").val();
        var type3 = $('select[name="type3"]').find(":selected").val();
        var type4 = $('select[name="type4"]').find(":selected").val();
            
//        var id = $(".add-to-cart-btn").data('id');
//        var id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
        var id = e.currentTarget.getAttribute('data-id');
        var qty = 1;
//        var price = $(".add-to-cart-btn").data('price');
//        var price = e.currentTarget.dataset.price;
        var price = e.currentTarget.getAttribute('data-price');
        
	$.ajax({
		type: "POST",
		url: SITEURL + "/ajax/cart.php",
		beforeSend: function(){
			$.LoadingOverlay("show");
		},
		dataType: 'json',
		data: {
			addtocart: id,
			qty: qty,
			price: price,
			type0: type0,
			type1: type1,
			type2: type2,
			type3: type3,
			type4: type4
		},
		success: function (res) {
			if(res.status == 1){
				var windowWidths = window.innerWidth ? window.innerWidth : $(window).width();
				if(windowWidths < 768){
					window.location.replace(SITEURL + "/cart/");
				}
				else {
					loadCart();
					
					//alert(res.related_products);
					
					var mcontent = '';
					mcontent += '' +
						'<div class="row">' +
							'<div class="col-md-1">' +
								'<img class="product-img" src="' + res.product.image + '" alt="' + res.product.title + '" />' +
							'</div>' +
							'<div class="col-md-6">' +
								'' + res.product.title + '' +
							'</div>' +
							'<div class="col-md-2 text-center">' +
								'' + res.product.product_discount.price + ' лв.' +
							'</div>' +
							'<div class="col-md-3 text-right">' +
								'<a href="' + SITEURL + '/cart/" class="btn btn-primary">виж количката</a>' +
							'</div>' +
							'' +
							'' +
							'' +
							'' +
							'' +
						'</div>' +
					'';
					
					if(jQuery.isEmptyObject(res.related_products) != true){
                                            	mcontent += '<hr />' +
						'<h4 class="margin-bottom-20">Други продукти, които може да харесате ...</h4>' +
						'<div class="well margin0 padding0">' +
							'<div class="margin10" style="position: relative;">' +
								'<div class="owl-carousel owl-loaded owl-nav-out" data-options=\'{"items":4,"loop":true,"nav":true}\' style="display: none; width: 100%">';
									
									$(res.related_products).each(function(key, val){
                                                                            var is_ebook = ""
                                                                            if(val.is_ebook){
                                                                                is_ebook = '<span class="label label-primary label-book-type" style="">' + val.type_name + '</span>';
                                                                            }
										mcontent += '' +
										'<div class="owl-item" title="' + val.product_title + '">' +
											'<div class="product owl-item-slide">' +
												'<div class="product-img-wrap-carousel margin10">' +
													'<a href="' + val.product_url + '">' +
														'<img class="product-img" src="' + val.product_image + '" alt="' + val.product_title + '" />' +
                                                                                                                is_ebook +
													'</a>' +
												'</div>' +
												'<a class="product-link" href="' + val.product_url + '"></a>' +
												'<div class="product-caption">' +
                                                                                                    '<ul class="product-caption-rating">'+val.rating_stars+
                                                                                                    '</ul>'+
         
													'<h5 class="product-caption-title" style="height: 40px;"><a href="' + val.product_url + '">' + val.product_title + '</a></h5>' +
													'<h6 class="product-caption-author">' + val.product_author + '</h6>' +
                                                                                                        '<div class="product-caption-discount">';
                                                                                                
                                                                                if(val.product_discount.percent > 0){
                                                                                    mcontent += '' + 
                                                                                            '<span class="product-caption-price-carousel">' + val.product_price + ' лв.</span>' +
                                                                                            '<span class="text-primary product-caption-price-carousel"> Отстъпка -' + val.product_discount.percent + '% </span>';
                                                                                }                        
                                                                                 mcontent +=  '<strong style="color:#f58220;">' + val.product_discount.price + ' лв.</strong></div>' +
												'</div>' +
											'</div>' +
										'</div>';
									});
									
						mcontent += '' +
								'</div>' +
							'</div>' +
						'</div>' +
						'';
					}
					
					doModal(res.msg, mcontent,'800px');
					
					$('#cart-msgholder').html('<div class="alert alert-success alert-dismissible text-center" role="alert">' +
						'<button type="button" class="close" data-dismiss="alert" aria-label="Close"><span aria-hidden="true">&times;</span></button>' +
						'Продуктът бе добавен във Вашата количка.' +
					'</div>');
				}
			} else {
				alert(res.msg);
			}
			$.LoadingOverlay("hide");
		}
	});
	return false;
	
});

        var id = $('select[name="coupon-price-select"]').find(":selected").val();
        var qty = 1;
        var couponid = $('select[name="coupon-price-select"]').attr('id');

	$.ajax({
		type: "POST",
		url: SITEURL + "/ajax/cart.php",
		beforeSend: function(){
			$.LoadingOverlay("show");
		},
		dataType: 'json',
		data: {
			'addcoupontocart': id,
			'qty': qty,
                        'couponid': couponid
		},
		success: function (res) {
			if(res.status == 1){
				var windowWidths = window.innerWidth ? window.innerWidth : $(window).width();
				if(windowWidths < 768){
					window.location.replace(SITEURL + "/cart/");
				}
				else {
					loadCart();
					
					//alert(res.related_products);
					
					var mcontent = '';
					mcontent += '' +
						'<div class="row">' +
							'<div class="col-md-1">' +
								'<img class="product-img" src="' + res.product.image + '" alt="' + res.product.title + '" />' +
							'</div>' +
							'<div class="col-md-6">' +
								'' + res.product.title + '' +
							'</div>' +
							'<div class="col-md-2 text-center">' +
								'' + res.product.product_discount.price + ' лв.' +
							'</div>' +
							'<div class="col-md-3 text-right">' +
								'<a href="' + SITEURL + '/cart/" class="btn btn-primary">виж количката</a>' +
							'</div>' +
							'' +
							'' +
							'' +
							'' +
							'' +
						'</div>' +
					'';
					
					if(jQuery.isEmptyObject(res.related_products) != true){
                                            	mcontent += '<hr />' +
						'<h4 class="margin-bottom-20">Други продукти, които може да харесате ...</h4>' +
						'<div class="well margin0 padding0">' +
							'<div class="margin10" style="position: relative;">' +
								'<div class="owl-carousel owl-loaded owl-nav-out" data-options=\'{"items":4,"loop":true,"nav":true}\' style="display: none; width: 100%">';
									
									$(res.related_products).each(function(key, val){
                                                                            var is_ebook = ""
                                                                            if(val.is_ebook){
                                                                                is_ebook = '<span class="label label-primary label-book-type" style="">' + val.type_name + '</span>';
                                                                            }
										mcontent += '' +
										'<div class="owl-item" title="' + val.product_title + '">' +
											'<div class="product owl-item-slide">' +
												'<div class="product-img-wrap margin10">' +
													'<a href="' + val.product_url + '">' +
														'<img class="product-img" src="' + val.product_image + '" alt="' + val.product_title + '" />' +
                                                                                                                is_ebook +
													'</a>' +
												'</div>' +
												'<a class="product-link" href="' + val.product_url + '"></a>' +
												'<div class="product-caption">' +
                                                                                                    '<ul class="product-caption-rating">'+val.rating_stars+
                                                                                                    '</ul>'+
                                                                                                    '<h5 class="product-caption-title" style="height: 40px;"><a href="' + val.product_url + '">' + val.product_title + '</a></h5>' +
                                                                                                    '<h6 class="product-caption-author">' + val.product_author + '</h6>' +
                                                                                                    '<div class="product-caption-discount">';
                                                                                                
                                                                                if(val.product_discount.percent > 0){
                                                                                    mcontent += '' + 
                                                                                            '<span class="product-caption-price-carousel">' + val.product_price + ' лв.</span>' +
                                                                                            '<span class="text-primary product-caption-price-carousel"> Отстъпка -' + val.product_discount.percent + '% </span>';
                                                                                }                        
                                                                                 mcontent +=  '<strong>' + val.product_discount.price + ' лв.</strong></div>' +
												'</div>' +
											'</div>' +
										'</div>';
									});
									
						mcontent += '' +
								'</div>' +
							'</div>' +
						'</div>' +
						'';
					}
					
					doModal(res.msg, mcontent,'800px');
					
					$('#cart-msgholder').html('<div class="alert alert-success alert-dismissible text-center" role="alert">' +
						'<button type="button" class="close" data-dismiss="alert" aria-label="Close"><span aria-hidden="true">&times;</span></button>' +
						'Продуктът бе добавен във Вашата количка.' +
					'</div>');
				}
			} else {
				alert(res.msg);
			}
			$.LoadingOverlay("hide");
		}
	});
	return false;
	
});

/*===================================================================================*/
/*  UPDATE CART QTY
/*===================================================================================*/
$(".ddd").on("click", function () {

	var $button = $(this);
	var $input = $button.closest('.input-group').find("input.table-shopping-qty");
	var oldValue = $input.val();

	if ($button.data('type') == "+") {
		var newVal = parseFloat(oldValue) + 1;
	} else {
		// Don't allow decrementing below zero
		if (oldValue > 1) {
			var newVal = parseFloat(oldValue) - 1;
		} else {
			newVal = 1;
		}
	}

	$input.val(newVal);
	setTimeout(updateCart, 2000);

});

/*===================================================================================*/
/*  UPDATE CART
/*===================================================================================*/
$('.table-shopping-qty').donetyping(function(){
	updateCart();
});

function updateCart(){
	$("#cart_form").ajaxForm({
		target: "#msgholder-cart",
		beforeSubmit: function(){
			$.LoadingOverlay("show");
		},
		type: 'POST',
		url: SITEURL + "/ajax/cart.php",
		resetForm : 0,
		clearForm : 0,
		dataType: 'json',
		/* data: {
			updateCart: 1
		}, */
		success: function(res){
			if(jQuery.isEmptyObject(res.errors)){
				window.location.reload();
			} else {
				//Reset input styles
				$("input.table-shopping-qty").css({
					'border': '1px solid #ccc'
				});
				//$(".error").remove();
				
				$.each(res.errors, function( index, value ) {						
					var tr = $('.table-shopping-cart').find('[data-id=' + index + ']');
					
					tr.css({
						'background': '#FFF7F7'
					});
					
					tr.find('input.table-shopping-qty').css({
						'border': '1px solid #F00'
					});
				});
				
				doModal('Грешка', 'Маркираните продукти в количката са с ' + res.errors.msg + '');

				$.LoadingOverlay("hide");
			}
			
			//$.LoadingOverlay("hide");
		}
	}).submit();
}

/*===================================================================================*/
/*  DELETE FROM CART
/*===================================================================================*/
$( ".delete-from-cart-btn" ).on( "click", function(event) {
	event.preventDefault();
	
	var parentEl = $(this),
		cart_id = parentEl.data('cart-id'),
		cart_item_id = parentEl.data('cart-item-id');
	
	var r = confirm('Сигурни ли сте, че искате да изтриете продукта от количката?');
	if(r) {
		$.ajax({
			type: "POST",
			url: SITEURL + "/ajax/cart.php",
			data: {
				'deleteCartItem': cart_id,
				'cart_item_id': cart_item_id
			},
			success: function (msg) {
				if(msg == 1){
					parentEl.closest('div.panel').fadeOut(function(){
						$(this).remove();
						window.location.reload();
					});
				}
			}
		});
	}
	return false;
	
});

		$span = $li.find('span.body');

		$span.show();

});

/*  CHANGE SHIPPINGPRICE FOR MULTI_CART IF PAYMENTMETHOD IS CHANGE
/*===================================================================================*/
$('.payment-methods-list_multy .payment_method_multy').on('click touchstart', function() {
      calculateMultyShipping();
});

$("input[id='subscribes']").on('click touchstart', function() {

       calculateMultyShipping();
});

function calculateMultyShipping() {
    var isNalojenPlatej = "0";
    var office_code = $('#econt_office').val();
    var econt_town = $('#econt_city').val();
    var econt_post_code = $('#post_code').val();
    var couponPayment = "0";
    var subscribes = "0";
    var shippmentType = $("input[name='shippment_type']:checked").val();
    
    if ($('#paymentMethodInput_multy5').is(':checked')) {
        isNalojenPlatej = "1";
    }
    
    if ($('.couponToUse_multy').is(':checked')) {
        couponPayment = $('.couponToUse_multy:checked').data('amount');
    }
    
    if($("input[id='subscribes']").is(':checked')) {
        subscribes = 1;
        //alert(couponPayment);
    }
    $.ajax({
            method: "POST",
            target: ".msgholder-ordermsg_multy",
            url: SITEURL + "/ajax/multi_checkout.php",
            data: {isNalojenPlatej: isNalojenPlatej, couponPayment: couponPayment, subscribe: subscribes, shippmentType: shippmentType, office_code: office_code, econt_town:econt_town,post_code:econt_post_code},
            success:function(data){
                var res = JSON.parse(data);
                if (res.msg) {
                    $(".msgholder-ordermsg_multy").html('' +
                        '<div class="alert alert-danger" role="alert">' +
                                res.msg +
                        '</div>' +
                    '');
                    
                }
                if (res.delivery) {                    
                    $('.shippingPrice_multy').html(res.delivery + ' лв.');
                }
                if (res.price) {
                    
                    $('.total_price_multy_calculated').html(res.price);
                }
                if (couponPayment !== "0") {
                    
                    $('.couponFinalPrice_multy').show();
                    
                    if (res.sum_user > 0) {
                        $('.final_price_calculated_multy').html(res.sum_user);
                    }else{
                        $('.final_price_calculated_multy').html(0.00);
                    }
                }else{
                    $('.couponFinalPrice_multy').hide();
                    
                }
                if (res.cart_arrays) {
                    
                    for (var i = 0; i < res.cart_arrays.length; i++) {
                        var object = res.cart_arrays[i];
                        $('#shippingPrice_multy' + i).html(object.delivery + ' лв.');
                        $('.total' + i).html(object.price + ' лв.');
                        $('#total_price' + i).html(object.total_price + ' лв.');
                        
                        $('.coupon_used' + i).html(object.coupon_used + ' лв.');
                        $('.sum_user' + i).html(object.sum_user + ' лв.');
                    }
                }
            }
        });
            return false;
}

/*===================================================================================*/
/*  CALCULATE SHIPPINGPRICE AJAX
/*===================================================================================*/

function calculateShipping(countryCode, shippmentType) {
    var isNalojenPlatej = "0";
    var office_code = $('#econt_office').val();
    var econt_town = $('#econt_city').val();
    var econt_post_code = $('#post_code').val();
    var couponPayment = "0";
    var subscribe = "0";
    shippmentType = $("input[name='shippment_type']:checked").val();
    if ($('#paymentMethodInput5').is(':checked')) {
        isNalojenPlatej = "1";
    }
    
    if ($('.couponToUse').is(':checked')) {
        couponPayment = $('.couponToUse:checked').data('amount');
        //alert(couponPayment);
    }
    
    if($("input[id='subscribe']").is(':checked')) {
        subscribe = 1;
        //alert(couponPayment);
    }

    $.ajax({
            method: "POST",
            target: ".msgholder-ordermsg",
            url: SITEURL + "/ajax/checkout.php",
            data: {country: countryCode, shippmentType: shippmentType, isNalojenPlatej: isNalojenPlatej, couponPayment: couponPayment, subscribe: subscribe, office_code: office_code,econt_town:econt_town,post_code:econt_post_code},
            success:function(data){
                var res = JSON.parse(data);
                
                if (res.msg) {
                    $(".msgholder-ordermsg").html('' +
                        '<div class="alert alert-danger" role="alert">' +
                                res.msg +
                        '</div>' +
                    '');
                    
                }

                if (res.delivery) {
                    $('.shippingPrice').html(res.delivery + ' лв.');
                }
                
                if (res.price) {
                    $('.total_price_calculated').html(res.price);
                }
                
                if (couponPayment != "0") {
                    $('.couponFinalPrice').show();
                    
                    if (res.sum_user) {
                        $('.final_price_calculated').html(res.sum_user);
                    }
                }else{
                    $('.couponFinalPrice').hide();
                }

            }
        });
            return false;
}

/*  CHANGE COUNTRY
/*===================================================================================*/


$('select[name="country"]').val('BG');
$('select[name="country"]').change(function(event){
    var val = $(this).find(":selected").val();
    var shippmentType;
    var courier = $("input[name='shippment_type_k']:checked").val();

    if(val == "BG"){
        $(".city").autocomplete({
            disabled: false
          });

        // Shipment Type = Speedy
        /*===================================================================================*/
        
        $('.speedy').show();
        $('.bg_posts').hide();
        $('.speedy1').show();
        $('.econt1').show();
        $('.bg_posts1').hide();
        $('.econt').hide();
        $('.speedy').find('#shippment_type_1').prop('checked', true);
        $('.speedy1').find('#shippment_type_1').prop('checked', true);
        $(".shipp_address").hide();
        $(".shipp_office").show();
        $('#paymentMethodLi5').show();
        
        $("input[name='shippment_type_k']").on("change", function() {
            var courier = $("input[name='shippment_type_k']:checked").val();
            $('.bg_posts').hide();
            
           if(courier == 2) {
                $('.speedy').show();
                $('.econt').hide();
                $('.speedy').find('#shippment_type_1').prop('checked', true);
                $(".shipp_address").show();
		$(".shipp_office").hide();
                $(".shipp_econt").hide();
           } else if(courier == 4) {
                $('.speedy').hide();                
                $('.econt').show();
                $('.econt').find('#shippment_type_5').prop('checked', true);
                $(".shipp_address").show();
		$(".shipp_office").hide();
                $(".shipp_econt").hide();
           } else if(courier == 3) {
                $('.speedy').hide();                
                $('.econt').hide();
                $('.bg_posts1').find('#shippment_type_3').prop('checked', true);
                $(".shipp_address").show();
		$(".shipp_office").hide();
                $(".shipp_econt").hide();
                $('.bg_posts1').show();
                $('.bg_posts').show();
           }
           calculateShipping(val, shippmentType);
        });
        $('#econt_office').on("change", function() {
            //var courier = $("input[name='shippment_type_k']:checked").val();
            //$('.bg_posts').hide();
            calculateShipping(val, shippmentType);
        });
        $('#post_code').on("change", function() {
            var courier = $("input[name='shippment_type_k']:checked").val();
            //$('.bg_posts').hide();
            if(courier == 3){
                
            } else {
                val = $('#country').val();
                calculateShipping(val, shippmentType);
            }
        });
        $("input[name='shippment_type']").on("change", function() {
            var courier = $("input[name='shippment_type_k']:checked").val();
            $('.bg_posts').hide();
            calculateShipping(val, shippmentType);
        });
        
        
        shippmentType = 1;
} else {
        $(".city").autocomplete({
            disabled: true
          });

        // Shipment Type = BG Posts
        /*===================================================================================*/
        $('.speedy').hide();
        $('.econt').hide();
        $('.speedy1').hide();
        $('.econt1').hide();
        $('.bg_posts1').show();
        $('.bg_posts').show();
        $('.bg_posts').find('#shippment_type_3').prop('checked', true);
        $('.bg_posts1').find('#shippment_type_3').prop('checked', true);
        
        shippmentType = 3;
        
        // Post Code
        /*===================================================================================*/
        $('input.post_code').val('');
        
        $('#paymentMethodInput5').attr('checked', false);
        $('#paymentMethodLi5').hide();
    }

//    calc_shipping_price();
    
    calculateShipping(val, shippmentType);
}).change();

$('.country').change(function(event){
    var val = $(this).find(":selected").val();
    
    if(val == "BG"){
        $(".city").autocomplete({
            disabled: false
          });
} else {
        $(".city").autocomplete({
            disabled: true
          });
    }
}).change();

/*  CHANGE SHIPPMENT TYPE
/*===================================================================================*/
function shippment_type_change_event(){
	if($('#checkout_page').length){
		var selector = $('input[name="shippment_type"]:checked');
		var selected_option = selector.val();

		} else if (selected_option == 4) {

                        $(".shipp_office").hide();
                        $(".shipp_econt").show();
                } else if (selected_option == 5) {
                        $(".shipp_address").show();
                        $(".shipp_office").hide();
                        $(".shipp_econt").hide();
                }

	}

function calc_shipping_price() {
	var shipping_price = $('input[name="shippment_type"]:checked').data('price');
	var total_price = $('[data-total_price]').data('total_price');
	
	console.log(shipping_price);
	
	var total_price2 = parseFloat(total_price) + parseFloat(shipping_price);
	total_price2 = parseFloat(total_price2).toFixed(2);
	
	$('.total_price_calculated').html(total_price2);


}

$(document).on('click', '.send-order-btn', function(e){
	e.preventDefault();
        
	$("#order_form").ajaxForm({
		target: ".msgholder-ordermsg",
		beforeSubmit: function(){
			$.LoadingOverlay("show");
		},
		type: 'POST',
		url: SITEURL + "/ajax/orders.php",
		resetForm : 0,
		clearForm : 0,
		dataType: 'json',
		data: {
			processOrder: 1
		},
		success: function(res){
                        resetInputStyles(".msgholder-ordermsg");
                        
			if(res.status == 1){
				window.location.href = SITEURL + "/thank-you.php?orderid=" + res.order_number + "";
			} else {

                            if(res.error_fields){
                                    //Reset input styles
                                    $("[data-name], input[type='text'], select, textarea").css({
                                            'border': '1px solid #ccc'
                                    });
                                    $('.checkbox-inline').css({
                                            'border': 'none',
                                            'background': 'none'
                                    });
                                    $(".error").remove();

                                    $.each(res.error_fields, function( index, value ) {
                                            var selector = $("#order_form " + index);
                                                    
                                            if(selector.is("input[type='checkbox']")){
                                                    selector.parent().parent('.checkbox-inline').css({
                                                            'border': '1px solid #F00',
                                                            'background': '#FFF7F7'
                                                    }).after('<small class="error" style="color: F00;">' + value + '</small>');
                                            } else {
                                                    selector.css({
                                                            'border': '1px solid #F00'
                                                    }).after('<small class="error" id="error"  style="color: F00;">' + value + '</small>').focus();
                                                    
                                            }
                                    });
                            }else{
                                    $(".msgholder-ordermsg").html('' +
						'<div class="alert alert-danger" role="alert">' +
							res.msg +
						'</div>' +
					'');
                                    $("html, body").animate({
                                            scrollTop: 0
                                    }, 600);
                            }

                            $.LoadingOverlay("hide");
			}
			
			//$.LoadingOverlay("hide");
		}
	}).submit();
});

function Countdown(options) {
	var timer,
	instance = this,
	seconds = options.seconds || 10,
	updateStatus = options.onUpdateStatus || function () {},
	counterEnd = options.onCounterEnd || function () {};

	function decrementCounter() {
		updateStatus(seconds);
		if (seconds === 0) {
			counterEnd();
			instance.stop();
		}
		seconds--;
	}

	this.start = function () {
		clearInterval(timer);
		timer = 0;
		seconds = options.seconds;
		timer = setInterval(decrementCounter, 1000);
	};

	this.stop = function () {
		clearInterval(timer);
	};
}

function UpdateQueryString(key, value, url) {
    if (!url) url = window.location.href;
	
    var re = new RegExp("([?&])" + key + "=.*?(&|#|$)(.*)", "gi"),
        hash;

    if (re.test(url)) {
        if (typeof value !== 'undefined' && value !== null)
            return url.replace(re, '$1' + key + "=" + value + '$2$3');
        else {
            hash = url.split('#');
            url = hash[0].replace(re, '$1$3').replace(/(&|\?)$/, '');
            if (typeof hash[1] !== 'undefined' && hash[1] !== null) 
                url += '#' + hash[1];
            return url;
        }
    }
    else {
        if (typeof value !== 'undefined' && value !== null) {
            var separator = url.indexOf('?') !== -1 ? '&' : '?';
            hash = url.split('#');
            url = hash[0] + separator + key + '=' + value;
            if (typeof hash[1] !== 'undefined' && hash[1] !== null) 
                url += '#' + hash[1];
            return url;
        }
        else
            return url;
    }
}

function updateFilters(value, url) {
    if (!url)
        url = window.location.href;
    var re = new RegExp("([?&])sort=.*?(&|#|$)(.*)", "gi"),
            hash;

    if (re.test(url)) {
        if (typeof value !== 'undefined' && value !== null) {
            var param = location.search.split('sort=')[1];
            if (window.location.href.indexOf(value) > -1) {
                var remove;
                if(window.location.href.indexOf(','+value) > -1) {
                    remove = ','+value;
                } else if(window.location.href.indexOf(value+',') > -1) {
                    remove = value +',';
                } else {
                    return url.replace(re, '');
                }
                var r = param.replace(remove,'');
                return url.replace(re, '$1sort='+r);
            } else {
                return url.replace(re, '$1sort='+ param + ',' + value + '$3');
            }
        }
    } else {
        if (typeof value !== 'undefined' && value !== null) {
            var separator = url.indexOf('?') !== -1 ? '&' : '?';
            hash = url.split('#');
            url = hash[0] + separator + 'sort=' + value;
            if (typeof hash[1] !== 'undefined' && hash[1] !== null)
                url += '#' + hash[1];
            return url;
        } else
            return url;
    }

}

$.mockjaxSettings.responseTime = 500;

var log = function (settings, response) {
	var s = [],
		str;
	s.push(settings.type.toUpperCase() + ' url = "' + settings.url + '"');
	for (var a in settings.data) {
		if (settings.data[a] && typeof settings.data[a] === 'object') {
			str = [];
			for (var j in settings.data[a]) {
				str.push(j + ': "' + settings.data[a][j] + '"');
			}
			str = '{ ' + str.join(', ') + ' }';
		} else {
			str = '"' + settings.data[a] + '"';
		}
		s.push(a + ' = ' + str);
	}
	s.push('RESPONSE: status = ' + response.status);

	if (response.responseText) {
		if ($.isArray(response.responseText)) {
			s.push('[');
			$.each(response.responseText, function (i, v) {
				s.push('{value: ' + v.value + ', text: "' + v.text + '"}');
			});
			s.push(']');
		} else {
			s.push($.trim(response.responseText));
		}
	}
	s.push('--------------------------------------\n');
	$('#console').val(s.join('\n') + $('#console').val());
}

$.mockjax({
            url: '/post',
            response: function (settings) {
                log(settings, this);
            }
        });

// AUTOCOMPLETE
$( function() {
    $( ".city" ).autocomplete({
      minLength: 1,
      source: function(request, response) {
        var filteredArray = $.map(projects, function(item) {
            if( item.label.toUpperCase().startsWith(request.term.toUpperCase())){
                return item;
            }
            else{
                return null;
            }
        });
        response(filteredArray);
    },
      focus: function( event, ui ) {
        $( ".city" ).val( ui.item.label );
        return false;
      },
      select: function( event, ui ) {
        $( ".city" ).val( ui.item.label );
        $( ".project-id" ).val( ui.item.post_code );

        $(".post_code").val(ui.item.post_code);
        return false;
      }
    })
    .autocomplete( "instance" )._renderItem = function( ul, item ) {
      return $( "<li>" )
        .append( "<div>" + item.label + "<br>" + item.post_code + "</div>" )
        .appendTo( ul );
    }
  });

}

 $( ".pop_360" ).on( "click", function() {
    var bookid = $(".pop_360" ).attr("id");
    
    var w = window.innerWidth;
    var h = window.innerHeight;
    var wh = 300;
    if (w <= h && w > wh) {
        wh = (w - 120);
    } else if (h <= w && h > wh) {
        wh = (h - 120);
    }
    
    if (wh > 999){
        wh = 999;
    } else if (wh < 300) {
        wh = 300;
    }
    
    $("#modal-body360").empty();
    
    var src = "https://partners.helikon.bg/magic360/?book_id=" + bookid + "&wh=" + wh;
    
    $("#modal-dialog360").width(wh + 25).height(wh + 95);
       
    var height = wh+9;
    $("#modal-body360").append("<iframe src="+ src +" height=" + height + " width=" + wh + " style='border:none;'></iframe>");
});

function doModal(title,content,width, footer) {
    if(footer != false){
        footer = true;
    }
    if(!title)
        title = false
    if(!width)
        width = '600px';
    
	var html = '';
	
	var windowWidth = window.innerWidth ? window.innerWidth : $(window).width();
	if(windowWidth < 768){
		width = false;
	}
	
	
    html +=  '<div id="dynamicModal" class="modal fade" tabindex="-1" role="dialog" aria-labelledby="confirm-modal" aria-hidden="true">';
		if(width){
			html += '<div class="modal-dialog"  style="width: ' + width + ';">';
		} else {
			html += '<div class="modal-dialog">';
		}
			html += '<div class="modal-content">';
				html += '<div class="modal-header">';
					html += '<a class="close" data-dismiss="modal">×</a>';
					if(title != false)
					html += '<h4 style="margin: 0;">' + title + '</h4>';
				html += '</div>';
				html += '<div class="modal-body">';
					html += '<p style="margin: 0;">';
						html += content;
					html += '</p>';
				html += '</div>';
                                html += '<div class="modal-footer">';
                                if(footer){
                                    html += '<span class="btn btn-primary" data-dismiss="modal">Затвори</span>';
                                }
                                html += '</div>';  // content
			html += '</div>';  // dialog
		html += '</div>';  // footer
    html += '</div>';  // modalWindow
	
    $('body').append(html);
	
	/* setTimeout(function(){
		$('.owl-carousel').owlCarousel();
		$('#rproducts').show();
	}, 2000); */
	
    $("#dynamicModal").modal();
    $("#dynamicModal").modal('show');
	
	$("#dynamicModal").on('shown.bs.modal', function() {
		if($('.owl-carousel').length){
			setTimeout(function(){
				$('.owl-carousel').owlCarousel();
				$('.owl-carousel').show();
			}, 500);
		}
    })

    $('#dynamicModal').on('hidden.bs.modal', function (e) {
        $(this).remove();
        window.location.reload();
    });

}

<script>
    
        $(function () {
            var windowWidth = window.innerWidth ? window.innerWidth : $(window).width();

            if (windowWidth > 768) {
                $(window).scroll(function () {
                    sticky();
                });

                function sticky() {
                    var header = $('.header-box').innerHeight();
                    var start_y = header;
                    var window_y = $(window).scrollTop();

                    if (window_y > start_y) {
                        $('#header-sticky').addClass('posi');
                    } else {
                        $('#header-sticky').removeClass('posi');
                    }
                }
            }
        });


    

</script>

        function clear_menu2(e) {
            //console.log('ss1');
            //console.log(e);
            var object = $('#collapsible-menu.collapse.in .dropdown-menu.collapse.in');
            var id = 0;
            if (e.localName == 'i') {
                id = $(e).parent().next().attr('id');
            } else if (e.localName == 'a') {
                id = $(e).next().attr('id');
            }
            var new_id = 0;
            for (i = 0; i < object.length; i++) {
                new_id = $(object[i]).attr('id');
                if (new_id != id) {
                    //console.log(i, new_id)
                    $('#collapsible-menu.collapse.in .dropdown-menu.collapse.in').removeClass('in');
                    $('#collapsible-menu.collapse.in .dropdown-menu.collapse.in').removeClass('collapse');
                }
            }
        }

        function showCampania(name) {
            //alert(name);
            //return "";
            var value = 'yes',
                    hours = 1;
            var expires;
            if (hours) {
                var date = new Date();
                date.setTime(date.getTime() + (hours * 1 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
                expires = "; expires=" + date.toGMTString();
            } else {
                expires = "";
            }
            document.cookie = name + "=" + value + expires + "; path=/";
            $('#showCampania').hide();
        }

        function getCampania(c_name) {
            //alert(c_name);
            //return "";
            if (document.cookie.length > 0) {
                var c_start = document.cookie.indexOf(c_name + "=");
                if (c_start != -1) {
                    c_start = c_start + c_name.length + 1;
                    var c_end = document.cookie.indexOf(";", c_start);
                    if (c_end == -1) {
                        c_end = document.cookie.length;
                    }
                    return unescape(document.cookie.substring(c_start, c_end));
                }
            }
            return "";
        }
